lead_headline: Claude Code closes 80+ issues in a single overnight sweep, then immediately takes on new ones
lead_body: A tight cluster of closures around 22:30 UTC cleared MCP failures, worktree isolation bugs, Windows crashes, and VS Code conflicts in what reads as a coordinated release push. Fresh reports filled the gap within the hour: an ECONNRESET hitting 40–70% of parallel fetches, a --bg-pty-host process pegged at 100% CPU, a --resume bug grafting stale tool-permissions onto the wrong conversation leaf, and one user who watched Claude spawn roughly 3,000 bash processes in seventeen seconds before an OOM reboot.
lead_article:
The headline today belongs to Claude Code, which closed an extraordinary sweep of issues overnight — somewhere north of eighty tickets resolved in a tight window around 22:30, covering the full spectrum from MCP server reliability and worktree isolation failures to Windows dispatch crashes and VS Code binary conflicts. That mass closure feels less like routine triage and more like a coordinated release push, and new issues are already filling the vacuum: an ECONNRESET hitting 40–70% of parallel startup fetches, a --bg-pty-host process spinning at 100% CPU on PTY EOF, a --resume bug that reconstructs a stale fork by grafting an orphaned tool-permission onto the wrong leaf node, and a report of Claude Code spawning roughly 3,000 parallel bash processes in seventeen seconds before an OOM reboot. The volume and diversity of fresh reports suggests a significant version landed and users are stress-testing it hard.

Workflow SDK had a quieter but tidy day: two documentation PRs merged — the child workflows cookbook pattern and an AI SDK cookbook fix — with three test PRs open against workflow-server. Astro was more active, shipping fixes for action pipeline caching in the base pipeline, sitemap index lastmod stamping, and a Svelte testing-library type correction, while a new issue flagged a route-cache overwrite warning flooding SSR production logs since 6.3.6. The AI SDK picked up a single PR adding a containerUpload option to pass files into Anthropic's code execution tool — small surface area, but it extends a capability that tends to compound.
